attributes.residual: MECHANISM FULLY NAMED, and it is a two-sided wall. MWCC unswitches this loop on the invariant `sVtxFormat == 1` into two complete bodies. The TARGET carries THREE things at once: two zero-initialised offset webs (`li r3,0` and `li r4,0` before the branch, one per unswitched copy, the format==1 copy using r4 and the else copy using r3), ONE shared FIFO base (`lis r5,-13311` hoisted above the branch), and NO copy between the offsets. Every source form reachable from here supplies only two of the three: one offset variable gives 1 li + 1 shared lis (87 insns, missing one li); two explicit source loops give 2 li + 2 lis (89 insns, one surplus lis); two variables in one loop give 2 li + 1 lis but the source-level `o1 = o2` copy (89 insns, the baseline). Getting two offset webs out of one source variable requires MWCC to rematerialise the zero into each unswitched copy's register instead of sharing one - an allocator decision, per the screened remat law.
